title: fix(app-showcase): record-action success toasts name the record
body:
Fixes #26459

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:showcase 的五个记录级动作(Mark Done、Recalculate Estimate、Recalculate Selection、Archive、Submit for Sign-off)的成功提示现在点名被改的记录,例如 "PII access review marked done.",发票用发票号 "INV-1002 submitted for finance + legal sign-off."。只改了 `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts` 里的 successMessage 文案,外加一个钉住提示原文的测试和一个 changeset。
- **为什么改**:用户连续标记多条任务完成时,每次都只看到 "Task marked done.",分不清改的是哪一条;裁决 C(#25849)要求记录级写操作点名记录(标题)或数量。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低,只动示例应用的文案。若某个列表行没带出 title 列,文案自动退回原来的对象措辞(如 "Task marked done."),不会出现空引号或原样的占位符。回滚即还原这一个提交。
- **先看**:`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts` 的五处 successMessage,以及新测试 `examples/app-showcase/test/record-action-success-names-record.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase exec vitest run test/record-action-success-names-record.test.ts`,10 条全绿;或启动 showcase,打开一条 done 为 false 的任务,点 Mark Done,提示应为该任务标题加 "marked done."。
- **需要你做的**:无须操作即可合入。可选:中文语言包里这几条 successMessage 仍是不带记录名的旧译文(本单按认领禁改语言包),是否另开卡由你定。

## What

The showcase's record-level actions now name the record they changed in their success toast:

| Action | Before | After (record carries its title) | After (no title bound) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mark Done | Task marked done. | PII access review marked done. | Task marked done. |
| Recalculate Estimate | Estimate recalculated. | Estimate recalculated for PII access review. | Estimate recalculated for the task. |
| Recalculate Selection | Estimates recalculated for the whole selection. | Estimates recalculated for PII access review. | Estimates recalculated for the whole selection. |
| Archive | Task archived (demo — no data changed). | PII access review archived (demo — no data changed). | Task archived (demo — no data changed). |
| Submit for Sign-off | Invoice submitted for finance + legal sign-off. | INV-1002 submitted for finance + legal sign-off. | Invoice submitted for finance + legal sign-off. |

## Why

Ruling C on #25849: a record-level write names the record (its title) or the count. The console renders an authored `successMessage` verbatim, so the fix is the showcase's own copy, not the runner.

## How the hole binds (read from the runner, not changed)

`ActionRunner.composeSuccessMessage` (objectui core) shows a `successMessage` as written unless it carries a template hole; then `fillTemplateHoles` fills it through `@objectstack/formula`'s `templateEngine` over exactly two roots: `result` (the handler's payload) and `record` (the dispatch's record: the clicked row's `_rowRecord`, else the page's record). So the record.title hole names a task and the record.name hole names an invoice (its "Invoice Number" field).

An unbound path prints EMPTY. A list row whose view does not project `title` would therefore have read as a sentence with a hole-shaped gap, so every message pipes the hole through the engine's `default` formatter, and falls back to the object wording the toast used before. No sentence can render a raw hole or an empty quoted name.

The count is not reachable from this copy: the copy's holes bind `record` and `result`, never the selection (`ctx.selection` is a target-interpolation scope only). It is also not needed. On the selection bar the aggregate dispatch runs with the success toast off (`ObjectGrid.runBulkActionAggregate` passes `showOnSuccess: false`), and the bulk dialog reports its own count ("Succeeded N / M"). The only placement where Recalculate Selection's toast shows is its declared `record_more` entry, a single-record dispatch, so it names that record and keeps "the whole selection" as the fallback.

- Red first, at `f9e79460` (pin only, copy unchanged): `vitest run test/record-action-success-names-record.test.ts`, 6 failed / 4 passed (10). The 4 that passed are the fallback cases, which equal today's wording by design. Example: `Expected: "PII access review marked done." Received: "Task marked done."`.
- Green: the same file, 10/10 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase test`: Test Files 40 passed (40), Tests 494 passed (494).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase validate` (`objectstack validate`, which judges action copy templates): Validation passed.

## Acceptance notes

- The zh-CN pack in `examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts` still carries the old record-less wording for these actions (e.g. 任务已标记为完成。). Locale packs are outside this card's claimed file surface, so a zh-CN viewer still sees no record name.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ux-conventions.json` quotes the old Mark Done string in its variant text. It is the QA ledger's evidence prose, left to the QA seat.
- `GenerateInvoicePdfAction` ("The PDF is attached to the invoice.") is also record-level copy, but the card does not name it, so it is unchanged.
